evals.prompt: Research xIELU for Zepto. Scope: standalone activation leaf, Apertus-8B prefill, training + inference on CUDA.
evals.expected_output: Complete research report in _workspace/research.md covering math definition, forward/backward FLOP step tables, memory and resource event chains, implementation catalog, YAML recipe spec, and cited sources.
assertions: Report contains Section 0 mathematical definition with tensor shapes
Forward FLOP derivation uses a step table before closed form
YAML block includes region_kind, resource_events_forward, resource_events_backward, saved_backward
Bibliography cites at least one primary source URL
Cross-checks registered region/xielu or notes to_implement status

evals.prompt: Analyze masked softmax for Zepto — fusion boundary B only, not full FlashAttention. Prefill, bf16, causal mask.
evals.expected_output: Report classifies boundary B, bills stable softmax at 5×|tile|, includes identity vs fused resource event chains side by side, and distinguishes paper 3hS² from kernel-accurate 5hS² when both appear.
assertions: Report explicitly labels fusion boundary B
Forward FLOP closed form uses 5*h*S^2 stable leaf or equivalent, with paper 3*h*S^2 labeled separately if mentioned
Contains both identity lowering and fused region resource event chains in Section 6.3
Bibliography cites at least one Transformers or Megatron/TE source

evals.prompt: Research GQA with FlashAttention boundary C for decode context (S_q=1, paged KV). Inference only.
evals.expected_output: Three-layer costing model, backward FLOPs = 0, documents (m,ℓ) saved-stats vs save-P tradeoff, no full (h,S,S) temps in fused path.
assertions: Backward FLOPs stated as 0 or Section 5 notes requires_grad=False
Memory section states no (h,S,S) score/weight temps for fused Flash path
Three-layer costing model names reference kernel, identity lowering, and Zepto region
Discusses saved activation strategy: row stats vs full P tensor
